fields.description: Stable identifier for this rule within the process (the 'rule_ref' an Arbor Process Run Expectation points back to). Survives reordering; the child-table idx is presentation order only.
fields.label: Rule Key

fields.description: Optional human label for the rule (canvas edge / dashboard). Never leaks a column key; redacted to a placeholder for viewers who cannot read a referenced column.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: What kind of Tree Event fires this rule. 'row' = a node (row) was created/updated (maps to the canvas START node). 'column' = a specific trigger_column was created/updated.
fields.label: Trigger Kind

fields.description: The Tree Column whose create/update fires this rule. Required when trigger_kind='column'; empty for a 'row' trigger.
fields.label: Trigger Column

fields.description: Which fire semantics: on first fill ('created'), on any later change ('updated'), or either ('created-or-updated').
fields.label: Trigger Op

fields.description: The columns this rule expects filled once triggered (an 'and' set sharing ONE window). Stored as a JSON array of Tree Column names. One Arbor Process Run Expectation is created per expected column.
fields.label: Expected Columns

fields.description: SLA window in seconds from trigger to expected fill; 0 means no SLA (the expectation never breaches).
fields.label: Within Seconds

fields.description: Notify the expected column's resolved owner when the expectation is opened (the trigger fired).
fields.label: Notify On Expect
